patch:
diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/budget.py b/src/evidence_harness/budget.py
index b9e0045..d7d128e 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/budget.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/budget.py
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 from __future__ import annotations
 
-FINALIZATION_TURN_RESERVE = 3
+FINALIZATION_TURN_RESERVE = 6
 FINALIZATION_WALL_TIME_RATIO = 0.1
 
 
diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py b/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
index f1a6340..b2f24f3 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
@@ -902,11 +902,9 @@ class EvidenceLoop:
         if not state.finalization_started:
             return tuple(ActionKind)
         turns_remaining = self._options.max_turns - state.turn_count
-        may_repair = (
-            bool(state.completion_findings)
-            and not state.finalization_repair_used
-            and turns_remaining >= 2
-        )
+        # One last work/repair batch stays available even before any finish attempt,
+        # so a larger finalization reserve does not remove needed work turns.
+        may_repair = not state.finalization_repair_used and turns_remaining >= 2
         if may_repair:
             return (ActionKind.EXECUTE, ActionKind.FINISH, ActionKind.STOP)
         return (ActionKind.FINISH, ActionKind.STOP)
